headline: Weathered Front Erupts as Mooring Lines Buckle
war_summary: Since the previous edition, WeatheredExpanseHex has become still more violent: twenty-four-hour base events have risen from thirty-six to thirty-seven, with six in the latest two hours, while both casualty rates accelerate. MooringCountyHex is now the other immediate flashpoint, recording fifteen daily events, ten in six hours and three in the latest two; its casualty and enlistment traffic is also climbing sharply, though the Warden side retains eleven of twelve strategic bases. StonecradleHex remains unsettled at seventeen daily events, but its latest two hours are quiet after four events in six hours, and its one-to-eight ownership split is unchanged. StlicanShelfHex has newly registered three events, all around Fort Hoarfrost, with activity continuing into the latest two hours amid accelerating losses on both sides. FarranacCoastHex and FishermansRowHex retain substantial older turnover—nine and fourteen daily events respectively—but neither has reported a fresh event in the latest six hours. LinnMercyHex likewise shows no new movement, while Callahans Passage remains a heavy casualty front without recorded base events.
